title: Orbit equivalence and total weak mixing of free group actions
summary: We prove that the orbit equivalence class of every free ergodic probability-measure-preserving (pmp) action of a free group contains a totally weak mixing action. Equivalently, every ergodic treeable pmp equivalence relation of cost $n\in\mathbf{N}\cup\{\infty\}$ is generated by a free totally weak mixing action of $\mathbf{F}_n$. This answers a question of Miller and Tserunyan.
